verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database, and outbound event webhooks are a fair capability for a database or platform to offer, so the axis applies. None of the evidence mentions registrable webhooks or outbound HTTP callbacks. The pack covers search, multi-tenancy, RBAC, deployment modes and an MCP server, none of which is a webhook mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
